title: Law to set default deadlines for city agency reports
summary: This bill would create a default due-date system for periodic reports that city agencies must submit to the Council when no specific deadline is set in law. Reports covering less than a year would be due at the end of the month following the reporting period, while reports covering a year or more would be due at the end of the second following month. It would also standardize how terms like month, quarter, half-year and fiscal year are interpreted in reporting requirements.
